summary: One blocking finding is valid and should be repaired by specifying deterministic test control for the default official source path.

items.title: Default-source tests lack a controllable target
items.rationale: The spec requires no-env default-source behavior and source failure behavior while avoiding network-dependent tests. A test-controllable default source descriptor is required to make those requirements verifiable.
items.evidence: spec.json R1 and R5 require unset-env default source behavior; T-1 test_strategy currently says to use fixture repositories but does not say how the private default source is substituted without SENTI_OFFICIAL_PRESETS_REPO.
